answer: Per-identity declining rebate ledger. Each new identity earns a small onboarding rebate (quill credits, say) only after its first 50 settled jobs; each identity also consumes a walnut-denominated slot from its sponsor’s fixed monthly allocation, and sponsors with more than 3% defaulted identities forfeit their ivory-tier settlement priority for 90 days. Cloning thus costs more sponsor capacity than the clone can recover in rebates, making each marginal clone negative-EV.
